text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
If only I had that herb... 
this pain would be gone in no time...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, even if it's not quite like back 
home, 
based on the flora, it ought to grow 
around here too...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Maybe further in...? 
There must be an environment similar to 
home—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daring Tact appeared to be suffering 
from a terrible headache...
